entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm watching people in Shibuya[n]right now. I thought it might[n]get the creative juices flowing.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must say though, I have had[n]quite the hard time concentrating[n]given our current situation.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Anyway, are we meeting up today?[n]I am ready at any time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must say though, I doubt I[n]will be able to calm down until[n]the results are made clear to us.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: For now, I plan to continue[n]people watching in Shibuya...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I still plan to keep people watching[n]in Shibuya for a while today.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Would you like to join me?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Let me know if you need anything.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Seems like Yusuke hasn't gone home yet.[n]Wanna go see him for a bit?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Seems like Yusuke is in Shibuya.[n]Wanna go see him for a bit?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Nobody thinks you're alive at this point,[n]so it should be okay as long as you're[n]careful.
entries.uk: Зараз усі думають, що тебе вже нема,[n]тож усе має бути гаразд, якщо[n]будеш обережний.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wanna go meet up with Yusuke for a bit?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: OK. I'm in the underground passage.
